scope: Read-only retrieval configuration research; no source/plan changes, CI dispatch, model inference, credentials read, or GitHub messages.

historically_published_swe_qa.warning: Published README protocol is historical, not equivalent to current executable default. It does not identify an exact Rust a424e0ce package identity.

retrieval_only.warning: File relevance can conceal missing causal source spans. This is not an answer-quality or e2e efficiency evaluation.

remote_configuration.upstream_variable_read: HTTP 404; this does not prove absence because permissions may hide the variable.
remote_configuration.warning: Use explicit fork endpoint for reproducibility; do not silently fall back to catalog endpoint. Embedding credential differs from GLM_API_KEY used for agent requests; existence metadata is not proof of working quota/model access.

pilot_isolation.current_factor: ci_run.upstream_protocol explicitly selects config[embedding_models][local] and asserts Potion; index_command is given that model; setup records local and endpoint null.
must_hold_constant: same trial count, reporting rules and frozen order policy
current_wrapper_not_ready_for_remote: workflow trial step supplies only agent ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/API_KEY, not embedding secret/endpoint.
ci_run index container does not receive embedding environment or explicit remote authorization/endpoint.
probe_mcp clones seeds but does not forward embedding credentials; remote query preflight would need this and saved workspace grant.
run.py already forwards EMBEDDING_ENV_NAMES only to zg when model is non-local, but this alone is insufficient.
metadata currently claims baked offline model cache and embedding_runtime local; these must describe the actual arm accurately.
collection secret scan and all setup/preflight paths must include embedding credentials without storing their value.
pilot_isolation.accounting: Index setup and its remote traffic/cost separate; remote query latency remains inside treatment agent wall time; report it rather than subtracting it. Changing provider/model/runtime is a declared embedding-stack factor, not proof of a pure encoder-weights effect.
pilot_isolation.comparison_design_inference: For a next single-case development iteration, a fresh baseline/local-zg/remote-zg three-arm block with unchanged agent settings would measure both e2e benefit and incremental stack change. Keep all arms/outcomes, then confirm a frozen choice on held-out cases. Do not compare fresh remote runs with a selected historical local run.

diagnostic_first.reason: Resource regressions alone do not show Potion retrieval is weak. Correct top-ranked locations can still lead to poor answer convergence or oversized reading.
diagnostic_first.proposed_read_only_replay: Freeze every observed successful treatment query before trying alternatives; replay same queries/root, index ignore, native MCP defaults and limit across hybrid/fts/vector and chosen embeddings. Keep failed/missing searches and all tasks, not only favorable queries.
measure: core evidence span coverage as actually returned in preview
gold file hit/rank and reciprocal rank
whether later agent readings add necessary context absent from search preview
diagnostic_first.interpretation: FTS is a useful embedding-independent reference. Better vector/file retrieval alone is not e2e improvement; require frozen fresh paired answer grading and complete usage.
diagnostic_first.no_existing_neural_reranker_toggle: Rust domain/model/reranking.rs is a future-backend contract only. Current documented reranking is rule scoring/fusion/diversity. Adding a learned reranker would be a product change, not selecting an existing configured profile.

no_claims: No verified controlled Potion-versus-Qwen embedding gain found in inspected sources.
Historical Opus gains are not evidence of Qwen3.8 + current Rust gains.
No current frozen batch was altered or rerun.
